description: Drafts an llms.txt for a site: the name and summary from its home page, then its pages from the sitemap grouped by section, with titles and descriptions read from up to 24 pages. Returns the file as text, for a person to edit before publishing. Free, no key. Docs: https://aeolookup.com/aeo-tools/llms-txt-validator/

max_links.description: Roughly how many links to include (default 40).

url.description: The page or site to check, for example https://example.co.uk/ (https:// is added if missing).

name: generate_llms_txt
title: llms.txt generator
